{{Top|leg}}
A '''groundcoach''' was a wide, [[Hovercraft|ground-effect vehicle]] that measured over eight [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and sat low to the ground. The driver's compartment of the groundcoach was open to the weather while the passenger cab was enclosed. This vehicle was very rich in its appointments, being the upgraded, luxury version of the [[groundlimo]].
